title: Latest F1 News
description: Don't miss a Formula 1 moment – with the latest news, videos, standings and results. Go behind the scenes and get analysis straight from the paddock.

items.title: How Justin Rose and McLaren are pursuing marginal gains in golf
items.content: Justin Rose explains how McLaren is bringing its Formula 1 engineering expertise and pursuit of marginal gains to the world of golf.
items.contentSnippet: Justin Rose explains how McLaren is bringing its Formula 1 engineering expertise and pursuit of marginal gains to the world of golf.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 杰森·罗斯（Justin Rose）介绍了梅赛德斯（McLaren）如何将其在一级方程式赛车领域的工程专长和追求边际收益的理念引入高尔夫运动。
summaries.en: Justin Rose discusses McLaren's collaboration with golf, applying Formula 1 engineering principles to achieve marginal gains in the sport. The partnership leverages McLaren's expertise in precision and efficiency to enhance golf equipment and performance. The focus is on small, incremental improvements to optimize results.

items.title: Inside F1’s ‘brutal’ fuel development race
items.content: Not only did F1 introduce new cars and new power units at the start of the 2026 season, but also Advanced Sustainable Fuels, a pioneering technology that teams – and their partners – have been pushing hard to maximise in terms of both performance and reliability.
items.contentSnippet: Not only did F1 introduce new cars and new power units at the start of the 2026 season, but also Advanced Sustainable Fuels, a pioneering technology that teams – and their partners – have been pushing hard to maximise in terms of both performance and reliability.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: F1在2026赛季引入新赛车和动力单元的同时，还推出了先进可持续燃料（ASF）。各车队及其合作伙伴正全力推动ASF在性能和可靠性方面的优化。这项创新技术成为赛季关注的焦点，竞争激烈。
summaries.en: F1 introduced new cars, power units, and Advanced Sustainable Fuels for the 2026 season. Teams and partners are intensively developing this pioneering technology to maximize performance and reliability. The focus is on advancing fuel technology amid the sport's ongoing evolution.

items.title: Why Williams' FW48 upgrade package in Baku is so crucial
items.content: Williams will introduce a long-awaited upgrade package at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
items.contentSnippet: Williams will introduce a long-awaited upgrade package at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 威廉姆斯将在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上推出备受期待的升级套件。此次升级对车队至关重要，旨在提升赛车性能，以应对激烈的竞争。
summaries.en: Williams will introduce a significant upgrade package for the FW48 car at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. This update is crucial as it aims to address performance limitations and enhance the team's competitiveness on the track. The timing of the upgrade comes at a key point in the season, potentially providing a vital boost to Williams' Formula 1 efforts. The package represents a major step in the team's strategy to improve results and secure better finishes in upcoming races.

items.title: Mekies offers update on Hadjar's injury recovery
items.content: Isack Hadjar has missed the three races since the summer break ended, sitting out Zandvoort, Monza and Madrid as he recovers from an injury sustained in training. The Frenchman hurt his wrist in the three-week break, and has been on the sidelines ever since.
items.contentSnippet: Isack Hadjar has missed the three races since the summer break ended, sitting out Zandvoort, Monza and Madrid as he recovers from an injury sustained in training. The Frenchman hurt his wrist in the three-week break, and has been on the sidelines ever since.
items.creator: Formula 1

summaries.zh: 梅基斯更新哈吉尔的伤情：法国车手因训练受伤已缺席夏季赛后三站比赛（赞德福特、蒙扎和马德里），手腕伤势在三周休赛期后持续恢复中，目前仍无法参赛。
summaries.en: Isack Hadjar has missed three races—Zandvoort, Monza, and Madrid—since the summer break due to a wrist injury sustained during training. The French driver injured his wrist three weeks before the break and has been sidelined ever since. Mekies provides an update on his recovery progress.
